summary: The manager tells the person the cut is about the business, not their work.
realLife: HR guidance says the message in a layoff meeting should center on the business reason, not the individual's performance, and careless remarks can leave the person feeling more wronged.
sources: SHRM, Layoffs require communication, compassion, compliance: https://www.shrm.org/mena/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/layoffs-require-communication-compassion-compliance
inGame: Job-ended event for a layoff, with the manager's traits deciding tone; the person's reaction by their traits.
